name: HTTP ( {request} )
purpose: Generic HTTP client: turns a request JSON (url, method, query, headers, basic auth, data) into cURL options, runs Insert from URL, and returns a JSON with status line, status code, response headers and body (body typed as object, array or string by Content-Type).
open_question: secret: step 95-98 puts the auth user and password into the cURL options (-u user:password), and step 83 puts caller headers (which may hold API keys or bearer tokens) into them; step 135 stores the whole option string, credentials included, in global variable $$lastCurlOptions. SSL certificates are not verified (step 125). Step 96 overwrites the URL-encoded user name from step 95. A 1631 error with status code 0 returns a failure JSON.
